name: Aru Douwa Kara no Dasshutsu ~Shirayuki Hen~
original_name: ある童話からの脱出～白雪編～
source:
The Snow White is a girlish boy who is widely known as he is the cutest one in the world.
But he and his new mother (queen) hate each other like cats and dogs.

Thus he has decided to escape from the mother's castle.

What awaits him the world outside of the castle...?

Will he be able to make his getaway from the Queen's scheme
to murder Snow White, the cutest one in the world...?

Let's solve mysteries and lead him out of the castle!


[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE216107.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
白雪公主是一位少女男孩，众所周知，他是世界上最可爱的男孩。
但他和他的新母亲（王后）却像猫狗一样互相憎恨。

于是他决定逃离母亲的城堡。

城堡外的世界等待着他的是什么……？

他能否逃脱女王的阴谋？
谋杀世界上最可爱的白雪公主……？

让我们解开谜团并带领他走出城堡吧！
